name: io.github.SaltyTaro/arcnautical
description: Screen any vessel by IMO for sanctions, ownership opacity and vetting grade. Keyless check included.

environmentVariables.name: ARCNAUTICAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Self-serve at https://arcnautical.com/arcnautical.html#/developer-api; unlocks the full screening record, batches and voyage scoring. check_vessel and find_port work without it.
